source='''def transform(grid):
    """Recover the 4x4 patch opposite the 3-marked area under 180-degree rotation."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells) + 1
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells) + 1
    source_r0, source_c0 = h - r1, w - c1
    patch = [row[source_c0:w - c0] for row in grid[source_r0:h - r0]]
    return [row[::-1] for row in patch[::-1]]
'''
